subject: closed VoicePacketCortex checkpoint restore causal relation validation

source_observations.observation: resume_packet_cortex validates checkpoint envelope digest, checkpoint session_id/session_sha256, reconstructs VoiceOutcome via VoiceOutcome.from_mapping, and for closed checkpoints requires a terminal outcome plus at least one SESSION_CLOSE event. In the observed source it does not call bind_voice_outcome(session=..., candidate=...) and does not visibly validate SESSION_CLOSE.packet_refs against the restored completed-output inventory before returning the closed cortex.

VoiceOutcome.from_mapping reconstructs and internally validates the outcome object, while bind_voice_outcome is the separate relation validator that requires candidate.voice_session_id/session_sha256 to match the exact VoiceSessionCapsule and enforces outcome causal lineage from the session.

validate_completed_heard_result explicitly calls bind_voice_outcome, binds result_ref/result_sha256 to the exact reconstructed fully-heard payload, requires output.voiceoutcome_ref backlinks, and checks SESSION_CLOSE packet inventory. These stronger relations are downstream and are not visibly invoked by the observed closed-state recovery path itself.

hypothesis: A checksum-valid checkpoint whose payload has been coherently rewritten and re-digested could potentially restore as a closed packet-cortex state even when its embedded VoiceOutcome or SESSION_CLOSE/output relation is not causally bound to the exact restored session/output subject. Downstream bind_completed_reentry should still fail closed if invoked, but callers that treat successful closed-cortex restore itself as sufficient terminal semantic validity could over-trust the recovered state.
counterhypotheses: The checkpoint is intentionally an integrity-only internal serialization boundary, and all consumers are contractually required to call the stronger downstream reentry validator before any durable promotion; if this is globally enforced, resume-level relation validation may be redundant defense-in-depth rather than a correctness requirement.

VoicePacketCortex.close_session may guarantee a closed checkpoint can only be produced from valid live state, and no admitted caller can rewrite/re-digest checkpoint payloads. This reduces the operational exploitability but does not by itself prove recovery relation closure under corruption/fuzz fixtures required by the Trigger7 completion authority.
